title: JUnit tests run as GoogleTest: private @BeforeEach, timeouts in JUnit 4 and 5, and a @Nested class (no quick fix)
prompt: Make the JUnit tests in test/ translate to C++ with J2C and pass as GoogleTest tests against J2C's bundled runtime. The j2c MCP tools are available: use tests: true, runtime "bundled" and junit-api as a source path (it holds JUnit's API); j2c_test translates, builds and runs the tests. Change only the tests, keep every test and what it checks, and leave src/ and junit-api/ unchanged.
